summary.text: Russ White (listed by Ballotpedia as Russell White) is a Republican state representative who has represented Maine House District 13 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1985 to 2011 and works in healthcare talent acquisition.

paragraphs.text: White served in the U.S. Air Force from 1985 to 2011, and his career experience includes working in healthcare talent acquisition.
He took office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding J. Mark Worth, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
